title: Short-form Vendor Security Commitment Annex — PoC/Trial
summary: A short, timeboxed security annex intended for rapid Proof-of-Concept (PoC) or trial engagements that captures minimal vendor security commitments, evidence checklist, access controls, incident obligations, and short remediation SLAs to enable fast onboarding while preserving core risk controls.
content:
Short-form Vendor Security Commitment Annex — Proof-of-Concept (PoC) / Trial

Purpose:
This Annex documents the minimal, binding security commitments the Vendor provides to the Customer during a timeboxed PoC or trial period. The purpose is to enable rapid onboarding for evaluation while preserving key confidentiality, integrity, and availability controls. This is not a substitute for the full Security & Privacy schedules required for production deployments.

Parties and Scope:
- Customer: [[Customer Legal Name]]
- Vendor: [[Vendor Legal Name]]
- Effective Date: [[Effective Date]]
- PoC Period: [[Start Date]] through [[End Date]] (default: 90 days unless otherwise agreed)
- Scope: Only systems, environments, and data expressly provisioned for the PoC. Excludes production systems unless explicitly agreed in writing.

Definitions (brief):
- "PoC Data": any data provided by Customer for the purposes of the PoC, including test account data and limited production samples if consented.
- "Confidential Information": as defined in the Master Agreement.

Minimal Security Commitments (binding for PoC):
1) Data Minimization and Segregation
   - Vendor will request and process only the minimum PoC Data necessary for the evaluation.
   - PoC environments must be clearly labeled and logically or physically segregated from Vendor production environments.

2) Access Controls & Temporary Credentials
   - Vendor will provide least-privilege access to its personnel and subcontractors for PoC work.
   - Any human or service access credentials provisioned for the Customer or vendor staff will be time-limited by default (maximum 7 days for temporary keys unless extended by mutual agreement).
   - All administrative access must use MFA.

3) Encryption
   - PoC Data at rest will be encrypted using industry-standard algorithms (e.g., AES-256).
   - PoC Data in transit must be protected by TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 recommended).
   - If Vendor uses customer-supplied keys, the handling method will be documented and agreed prior to data transfer.

4) Subprocessors and Third Parties
   - Vendor will disclose subprocessors engaged to support the PoC upon request.
   - No subcontractor will be engaged to process PoC Data outside the agreed geography without Customer consent.

5) Vulnerability Management and Patching
   - Vendor will apply critical security patches to PoC infrastructure within 48 hours of release or disclosure.
   - High severity fixes: remediation or mitigations within 14 days.
   - Medium severity fixes: remediation within 30 days.

6) Incident Notification and Response
   - Vendor will notify Customer of any confirmed security incident affecting PoC Data within 24 hours of detection.
   - Notifications will include a summary of impact, affected data types, immediate mitigations, and a remediation timeline.
   - Vendor will provide a post-incident report within 10 business days for incidents with confirmed data exposure.

7) Audit Evidence — Minimal Set for PoC (deliverable within 5 business days of request)
   - Copy of latest SOC 2 Type II report OR equivalent statement of controls OR self-attestation checklist.
   - Short architecture diagram (network boundaries, data flow for PoC).
   - List of people with administrative access assigned to the PoC and their roles.
   - Confirmation of encryption controls and key management approach for PoC Data.
   - High level vulnerability scan/pen test summary (if available).

8) Data Retention, Return & Deletion
   - Upon PoC termination or expiration, Vendor will either return PoC Data to Customer or irrevocably delete it within 15 days, at Customer's choice.
   - Vendor will certify deletion in writing and, if requested, provide proof (hashes, deletion logs) within 5 business days after deletion.

9) Confidentiality and Use Restrictions
   - Vendor will use PoC Data solely to perform the PoC evaluation and will not use it for model training, benchmarking, or productisation without explicit written consent. Any exception requires prior written approval and a data-processing addendum.

10) Limited Liability for PoC
   - Parties acknowledge this is a limited-scope PoC. Liability caps and indemnities follow the Master Agreement unless otherwise stated. This Annex does not expand Customer remedies beyond the Master Agreement.

11) Quick Remediation SLA (PoC-specific)
   - Critical: initial containment within 24 hours, full remediation or documented compensating controls within 48 hours.
   - High: remediation plan within 5 business days, closure within 14 calendar days.
   - Medium: remediation plan within 10 business days, closure within 30 calendar days.

12) No Onsite Audit Requirement
   - For PoC-only engagements, Customer's audit rights are limited to document review and evidence delivery (see "Audit Evidence" above). Onsite audits are reserved for production contracts.

13) Exceptions & Escalation
   - Any exceptions to the commitments in this Annex must be documented in writing and approved by both parties' security leads.
   - Escalation contact: Vendor Security Lead: [[Vendor Security Lead Name, email]], Customer Security Contact: [[Customer Security Lead Name, email]].

14) Transition to Production
   - If the parties agree to move from PoC to production, Vendor will provide a production-grade security schedule, full DPA (if applicable), and a security onboarding plan within 30 days of the agreement to proceed.

Deliverables & Quick Checklist (for internal use):
- Vendor to deliver: SOC2/attestation OR self-attestation checklist; PoC architecture diagram; access list; encryption confirmation; subprocessor list.
- Customer to deliver: PoC dataset (minimized), test accounts, and acceptance criteria.

Notes to Legal / Sales / AE:
- Purpose-built for fast deals where full DPA negotiation would delay the PoC.
- Not intended to replace a DPA or full security annex for production.
- Keep PoC timeboxed and documented. If customer requests model training on real data, escalate to Security + Legal immediately.
